step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture tracks speedtest data from consumers into a processing pipeline. Consumers send reports to an API Server (EC2) which ingests them into Kinesis. The data is enriched using facts from RDS, then forwarded to Kinesis Firehose, which stores them in an S3 Data Lake. From S3, a Lambda function triggers to normalize data into CSVs and loads them into Redshift. Aggregated insights from Redshift are written back to RDS to be served to consumers through the API. Additionally, Athena is used to query the S3 Data Lake directly.

graph.name: Ookla Speedtest Data Pipeline Architecture
graph.notes: Ookla uses a Kinesis and Lambda-driven serverless pipeline to ingest, enrich, and analyze 4,000 speedtest reports per second, processing over 5 PB of data.
